title: Splitting sums of binary polynomials
summary: We study an analogue of a classical arithmetic problem over the ring of polynomials. We prove that $m = 5$ is the minimal number such that the sums of any two distinct polynomials in a set of $m$ polynomials over $\F_2[x]$ cannot all be of the form $x^k(x+1)^{\ell}$.
